name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 5 visits over 41 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 44 hours starting 2026-05-19, at wavelengths from 0.91 to 5.00 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
